tests.command: guest init shell: nonce assignment, export, test, echo
tests.expected_result: init prompt plus host-command and exported-environment nonce markers

tests.command: create, overwrite, read, delete a nonce file; sync; reboot; compare SHA-256
tests.expected_result: exact modified contents before delete; deleted file stays absent; retained marker hashes match across reboot

tests.command: interactive Yash: command, exported environment, pipeline, redirection, child, exit
tests.expected_result: nonce markers and return to parent shell

tests.command: open new file, type nonce, Ctrl-S, Ctrl-Q, read file
tests.expected_result: saved file contains exactly the typed nonce

tests.command: vim --version; vim -u NONE -i NONE -n -es -c setline -c wq; cat file
tests.expected_result: Vim starts and saves one exact nonce line

tests.command: create C source; edit output string; chibicc -S; as; ld with pinned CRT/libc/libgcc; run both versions
tests.expected_result: both unique program output markers appear after their respective builds

tests.command: /usr/bin/make -f Makefile; edit source; make -n; make; run program
tests.expected_result: first and edited program markers; dry-run schedules chibicc rebuild

tests.command: as objects; ar rcs; ranlib; ar t; ld archive; execute
tests.expected_result: member.o listed and executable prints nonce marker

tests.command: samu -h; samu -n; samu; edit source; samu -n; samu; run output
tests.expected_result: help is printed, build edge appears, and changed source yields changed output
